page.layout: One printed title page within a woodcut border; all text centred in the framed central panel. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The title is set within an ornamental woodcut border with figures (Adam and Eve scene at top, a bearded evangelist figure at right, medallion scenes below); these engravings are not transcribed. Some letters in the title are worn; "descripta" and "Indice" read as printed. Line-end hyphens in "APOSTOLO-RVM" and "LV-cam" are printed hyphens.
